sectors.label: AI / Telco / ICT
sectors.scope: Malaysia-related AI, telecoms, ICT, digital infrastructure, data centres, cloud, technology investment, adoption and regulation.

sectors.label: Property Development
sectors.scope: Property launches, development projects, sales, land transactions, relevant policy and company developments.

sectors.label: Construction
sectors.scope: Contracts, tenders, project delivery, order books, costs, capacity, financing and material company developments.

sectors.label: Property Investment
sectors.scope: Retail property investment, malls, retail landlords and relevant retail-asset REIT developments. Do not silently broaden into all office-property news.

sectors.label: Plantation
sectors.scope: Plantation businesses, palm oil, production, stocks, exports, costs, labour, policy and material company developments.

sectors.label: Capital Financing
sectors.scope: Licensed moneylending and relevant capital-financing developments. Verify financial and regulatory terms precisely.

sectors.label: Consumer Financing
sectors.scope: Consumer-financing developments relevant to civil servants, including applicable lenders, cooperatives and policy.

sectors.label: Cables Manufacturing
sectors.scope: Cable makers, orders, manufacturing capacity, costs and demand from grid, construction and data-centre projects.

sectors.label: Building Materials / Wall Panels / IBS
sectors.scope: Wall panels and industrialised building systems, plus the named building-materials watchlist companies. Do not replace IBS/wall-panel scope with generic materials news.

sectors.label: Hotels
sectors.scope: Hotel operators, investment, openings, operating performance, occupancy, tourism demand and relevant policy.
